parameters.query:
SELECT $1::text AS submitted_id, $2::text AS submitted_text, t.*
FROM (SELECT 1) AS seed LEFT JOIN team_request t ON t.request_id = $1

INSERT INTO team_request(request_id, request_text, spec_sha, category, evidence, answer, title, body, state)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)
ON CONFLICT(request_id) DO UPDATE SET request_id = excluded.request_id
RETURNING team_request.*, $2::text AS submitted_text
